decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the firm's established office offer into a growing workplace segment, and with stable industry turnover and the firm hiring, it is likely meeting aspirations and gets time to mature.

A chair family close to the core range uses existing craftsmanship and sales channels at low incremental cost, and a shortfall would not trigger problemistic search in a firm that is not under pressure.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a small accessory with uncertain demand, but available slack and its link to the rug range let the firm carry it a while longer.
The upholstered sofa sits close to the core living range, and although it is only mentioned on the website rather than featured, it costs little to keep in the portfolio.
The high standing table fits the firm's lounge and conference offer and its trend toward flexible workplaces, so it likely contributes to project sales and stays.

The rug collection is distant from the core business and its results are uncertain, but it is prominently presented and supports the curated-materials strategy, and slack allows the firm to keep it during its early phase.
